I have farmed this land in Oromia for many years, and for this 0.57-hectare plot I plan to grow teff or barley using seed I saved from last season. I will apply a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative if the supply arrives in time, and I will spread whatever cow manure I have because the soil needs help after last year. My family and I will do the ploughing, planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, but I will likely hire a few day laborers when the weeding and harvest get heavy. I do not have money for pesticides or any way to irrigate, so I am relying on the rains as always.
